That “paste and save” flow now works.

Try it at [http://maker:4000](http://maker:4000):

1. Click **Add bookmark**.
2. Paste any public webpage URL.
3. Stash displays **Reading the page…**
4. It automatically fills the title, description, canonical URL, site identity, preview image, and available keywords.
5. Review or adjust the details, then click **Save to Stash**.

I verified the full flow using an MDN article. Its title and 196-character description were fetched and saved successfully.

If a website blocks metadata access, Stash clearly reports that and still lets you save the URL manually.
